text: パルシェン　もっと　そだてたら　しんじゅも　おっきく　なるかしら

structure.jp: もっと　そだてたら
おっきく　なるかしら
structure.en: I wonder if it will get bigger

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on the end of a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. そだてたら = 'if I raise it'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: The く form of a describing word with なる means 'become that way'. おっきく　なる = 'get bigger'.

patterns.name: 〜かしら
patterns.explanation: かしら at the end means 'I wonder', in a feminine way of speaking. なるかしら = 'I wonder if it will become'.
